signature_contract.source: JUnit XML (--junit-xml, xunit2 family) — structured results, no terminal-text parsing
signature_contract.canonical_form: JSON {schema_version, mutation_id, exit_code, failed:[{nodeid, phase}] sorted} with sort_keys + compact separators; sha256 of that text
signature_contract.phase_handling: failure element -> phase 'call'; error element -> 'setup_or_teardown' (collection errors surface as error elements); known limitation: parameterized nodeids not present in this suite
